description.value:
Frequency once per day

Area 30-foot emanation

You open the Hollow to every unbound Drifter within reach. Every creature in a 30-foot emanation is subjected to your Covenant's signature effect at once — Dead Hand's Grip, Borrowed Grief, or The Long View — at its greatest intensity, with no target selection and no way to exclude allies. Afterward you suffer the maximum result on your Fraying die automatically. You do not roll, Weathered Seal cannot downgrade it, and no ability of yours or anyone else's may prevent, reduce, or delay it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Grants a wholly new usable multi-target action built from an existing ability -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention, always INCOMPLETE regardless of real analogs shipping rules: []. Compounding: the "signature effect" varies per Covenant (three different abilities, each independently SKIP/informational on its own card), so there is no single mechanical hook to AoE-ify even setting bucket 3 aside. The automatic max-Fraying-die trigger is unbuildable regardless -- Fraying has no rule-element representation anywhere (see classes.hollowbound.json).
